bear_assumptions: Credit losses and funding costs rise, currencies weaken, regulation or competition slows fintech and commerce, and margins compress under logistics investment.
base_assumptions: Commerce, payments and advertising sustain strong local-currency growth; credit normalizes without a funding shock and operating margins remain disciplined.
bull_assumptions: Fintech and commerce compound above expectations, logistics density and advertising lift margins, credit performance improves and currency/funding conditions remain manageable.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if credit quality, cash conversion and an accepted relationship clear downside and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade on rising losses, funding stress, currency/regulatory impairment or weaker commerce and payments economics.
